market_definition: The polyvinyl acetate adhesives market comprises water-based emulsion adhesives built on PVAc homopolymers or copolymers, commonly known as white or wood glue. It measures sales of finished adhesives for wood, paper and porous-substrate bonding. BY POLYMER TYPE: PVAc Homopolymer, PVAc Copolymer, Cross-Linkable PVAc (D3 / D4 Grade). BY PERFORMANCE CLASS: Interior Grade, Water-Resistant Grade, Fast-Set Grade. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Furniture & Cabinetry, Wood Flooring & Panels, Engineered Wood & Timber Construction, Paper & Packaging, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Vinyl acetate ethylene emulsion adhesives; polyvinyl alcohol adhesives; acrylic emulsion adhesives; PVAc as raw emulsion for paints. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
